AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: This app helps users search products, manage groceries, cook with AI assistance, manage coffee orders, and manage wardrobe items. Operational Patterns: - Use 'searchProducts' to find catalog products or groceries; use the returned id with 'addToCart'. - Use 'addToCart' to prepare a cart change, then require the user to review and confirm checkout. - Use 'orderCoffee' to prepare a coffee order in the cart. - Use 'saveWardrobeItem' to add an item to the wardrobe. - Use 'viewOrder' to retrieve the details of an order. Constraints: - Coffee size must be one of Small, Medium, Large. - Product IDs must come from a current search result. - Never claim a purchase or checkout completion without app confirmation. - Wardrobe item name must not be empty.
